name: What is included in interior finishing for a residential remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is included in interior finishing for a residential remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior finishing covers the final architectural and aesthetic details that make a room complete and livable after rough construction. This includes framing adjustments, drywall installation and texturing, interior door hanging, baseboards, crown molding, tile and marble setting, and final painting. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site trim, drywall, and tile work directly, ensuring every surface aligns smoothly before final finishes are applied. Skipping proper surface prep or hiring mismatched trades can result in crooked trim lines or uneven tile, making cohesive interior finish work essential for a clean result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior finishing includes drywall, texturing, trim carpentry, baseboards, doors, tile installation, and interior painting that turn rough construction into a finished room.
